subject: general
question: A is the sister of F and wife of B. C is the son of D's paternal grandfather. B is the father of E. C is the son of F. How is A related to C?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: X is the only daughter of Y's maternal grandmother.​

1) A is the sister of F and wife of B.

2) B is the father of E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/704317b8696766766570b0ea954cde0635636b825c12ec84914e5fdba46581a4.png] 

3) C is the son of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/193b31c755c0d6831db17f5c1195523952c50dc34ec301a760d46bceb702a211.png] 

4) C is the son of D's paternal grandfather.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0b8218f06f20afb03f027782180bc507b6f771f01cf54dde3b155152b6000a0.png] 

Thus, A is C's paternal aunt or father's sister.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
